description: This file contains helper functions to create default configuration objects for sandbox environments, including browser configuration, prune settings, and SSH configuration with optional overrides.

methods.name: export function createSandboxBrowserConfig( createSandboxBrowserConfig
methods.description: Creates a SandboxBrowserConfig object with default values, allowing optional overrides.

methods.name: export function createSandboxPruneConfig( createSandboxPruneConfig
methods.description: Creates a SandboxPruneConfig object with default values, allowing optional overrides.

methods.name: export function createSandboxSshConfig( createSandboxSshConfig
methods.description: Creates a SandboxSshConfig object with defaults, requiring a workspaceRoot parameter, and allows overrides.
